public.title: Deep Clone II
public.description: input {nodes,root,edits}; nodes is an object mapping IDs to {value,edges:[IDs]}, representing a possibly cyclic graph. Clone the reachable graph from root, preserving IDs and edge order. Then apply edits {id,value} only to clone node values (edited IDs are reachable). Return {original:nodes,clone:reachableNodes}; unreachable original nodes stay only in original. This explicit graph adapter tests cycle-safe traversal and clone-only changes without relying on object identity. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Register each copied node before visiting neighbors to break cycles, then mutate only clone values. O(V plus E plus payload bytes) time and space on the reachable graph, plus the original snapshot. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
